mapper.select: SELECT q.question_code, so.option_code FROM user_survey_answers usa JOIN survey_options so ON so.id = usa.option_id JOIN survey_questions q ON q.id = so.question_id WHERE usa.survey_id = #{surveyId} AND q.question_code IN ('COMMON_PRIORITY', 'OFFICE_STYLE', 'OFFICE_NOISE')

SELECT m.id AS merchantId, m.name AS merchantName, CAST(m.latitude AS DECIMAL(10, 8)) AS latitude, CAST(m.longitude AS DECIMAL(11, 8)) AS longitude FROM reservations r JOIN reservation_products rp ON rp.id = r.product_id JOIN merchants m ON m.id = rp.merchant_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.workation_id = #{workationId} AND r.status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'COMPLETED') AND m.category = 'ACCOMMODATION' ORDER BY r.start_date ASC, r.id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT m.id AS merchant_id, m.name, m.address, m.thumbnail_url, m.price, m.latitude, m.longitude, m.rating, CAST(COUNT(r.review_id) AS UNSIGNED) AS review_count, o.noise_level, COALESCE(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN r.atmosphere = 'QUIET' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS UNSIGNED), 0) AS quiet_review_count, COALESCE(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN r.atmosphere = 'OPEN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS UNSIGNED), 0) AS open_review_count, COALESCE(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN r.atmosphere = 'COLLAB' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS UNSIGNED), 0) AS collab_review_count, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bookmarks b WHERE b.users_id = #{userId} AND b.merchants_id = m.id AND b.is_deleted IS NULL ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bookmarked FROM merchants m INNER JOIN offices o ON o.merchant_id = m.id LEFT JOIN reviews r ON r.merchant_id = m.id AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE m.category = 'OFFICE' AND m.region_id = #{regionId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM reservation_products rp INNER JOIN product_daily_inventories pdi ON pdi.product_id = rp.id WHERE rp.merchant_id = m.id AND pdi.is_available = 1 AND pdi.remaining_capacity > 0 AND pdi.inventory_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ) GROUP BY m.id, m.name, m.address, m.thumbnail_url, m.price, m.latitude, m.longitude, m.rating, o.noise_level ORDER BY m.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recommendation_requests ( user_id, workation_id, reference_merchant_id, secondary_reference_merchant_id, recommendation_type, reference_type, meal_type, reference_latitude, reference_longitude ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{workationId}, #{referenceMerchantId}, #{secondaryReferenceMerchantId}, #{recommendationType}, #{referenceType}, #{mealType}, #{referenceLatitude}, #{referenceLongitude} )

INSERT INTO recommendation_results ( recommendation_request_id, merchant_id, price_score, preference_score, accessibility_score, rating_score, total_score, ranking ) VALUES
(#{requestId}, #{result.merchantId}, #{result.priceScore}, #{result.preferenceScore}, #{result.accessibilityScore}, #{result.ratingScore}, #{result.totalScore}, #{result.ranking})
